entity.name: UAV4GEO
entity.description: UAV4GEO stewards the WebODM ecosystem, a set of free and open source tools for processing aerial imagery into maps, point clouds, 3D models and elevation models. 100% of the funds go to engineering, research, infrastructure and development of WebODM, ODX, NodeODX, OpenSplat and the upstream projects they depend on.

projects.name: WebODM
projects.description: User-friendly, commercial-grade software for processing aerial imagery. Generates georeferenced maps, point clouds, elevation models and textured 3D models from drone images, with a web interface, plugins and an API.

projects.name: ODX
projects.description: Command line toolkit to generate maps, point clouds, 3D models and DEMs from aerial and ground images. The processing engine behind WebODM.

projects.name: NodeODX
projects.description: REST API to access photogrammetry engines such as ODX. Lets WebODM and other applications distribute processing across machines.

projects.name: OpenSplat
projects.description: Production-grade 3D gaussian splatting with CPU/GPU support for Windows, Mac and Linux.
